# Creatify

> Creatify is a digital media agency based in Multan, Pakistan, building websites, Shopify and WordPress stores, and running SEO and social media marketing for small and mid sized businesses. Senior-level work handled directly by the team, no junior hand offs.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://www.creatify.site/services/web-development/): Custom, fast, responsive websites built to convert visitors into customers.
- [Shopify Development](https://www.creatify.site/services/shopify-development/): Custom Shopify storefronts, theme customization, and app integrations for ecommerce brands.
- [WordPress Development](https://www.creatify.site/services/wordpress-development/): Custom WordPress themes, plugin development, and maintainable builds.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://www.creatify.site/services/seo/): Technical SEO, content strategy, and on-page optimization for long-term organic growth.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.creatify.site/services/social-media-marketing/): Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Google ad campaigns managed for return on ad spend.
- [Graphic Designing](https://www.creatify.site/services/graphic-designing/): Logos, brand identity, and marketing visual assets.
- [Video Editing](https://www.creatify.site/services/video-editing/): Editing for social media, ads, and marketing campaigns.
- [Digital Strategy](https://www.creatify.site/services/digital-strategy/): Data-driven strategy that ties website, SEO, and ad work together.
